It Combines the representation of two movements with similar interests and goals, the International Catholic Movement for Intellectual and Cultural Affairs (ICMICA or ICMICA/MIIC) and the International Movement of Catholic Students (IMCS or IMCS/MIEC). These two groups operate independently, but share the common name of Pax Romana [1][2]. The organization has many focuses, some of which are human rights, democracy, education, eradication of poverty, sustainable development, and inter-cultural/inter-religious dialogue [1][2]. Each of these focuses is approached from the perspective of Catholic social teaching. Pax Romana has representatives in various international bodies including the United Nations and has a special consultative status with ECOSOC (Economic, Social and Cultural Council) of the United Nations [4].
